entities.summary: Rolando Florencio Romero Moreno, known as Rolly Romero, is a Cuban-American professional boxer. He is a world champion in three weight classes, having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) welterweight title since August 2025. He previously held the World Boxing Association (WBA) super lightweight title from 2023 to 2024 and the World Boxing Association (WBA) interim lightweight title in August 2020.
